title: PACK-15 eligibility-stream event payload (v1)
description: Produced by epd2_eligibility_service.voting_trust_events.build_eligibility_event. Shared by the nine eligibility-stream event types: eligibility.requested, eligibility.evaluation_started, eligibility.approved, eligibility.denied, eligibility.review_required, eligibility.evidence_referenced, eligibility.decision_expired, eligibility.disputed, eligibility.dispute_resolved (docs/packs/PACK-15/PACK-15-EVENT-CATALOG.md). The six decision-derived properties are present only when a decision exists, which is why they are optional rather than required. It deliberately omits every identity-side field the case itself holds - participant_reference, the scoped attributes, the evidence references and the assisted party's identity - carrying only the boolean fact that assistance occurred, because identification stops at the case (ADR-089) and never reaches the wire.
